name: arith_sigma_mul_totient_lt_sq
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n * n.totient < n ^ 2
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n * n.totient < n ^ 2
informal: σ(n)φ(n) < n² for n ≥ 2 — both sides multiplicative; on a prime power σ(p^a)φ(p^a) = p^(a-1)(p^(a+1)-1) < p^(2a); multiply over the factorization (strong induction splitting off ordCompl).
